gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: Teacher and control each finished both consumed TRAIN cells. Paired laps were 22.34 versus 23.78 seconds and 21.38 versus 22.56 seconds; teacher median 21.86 versus control 23.17 seconds is a 5.65% improvement, exceeding the preregistered 3% feasibility gate. This is only a teacher feasibility pass, not candidate score evidence.
